Level 5 Bastion Facility

Prerequisite: Renown 10+ with any dragonmarked house
Space: Roomy
Hirelings: 1
Order: Empower

Space set aside for your dragonmarked house. The hireling is a house agent who serves as your liaison with your superiors. When you add this facility to your Bastion, your Renown Score with your house increases by 1.

Dragonmark Empowerment (Requires Any Dragonmark Feat). When you finish a Long Rest in your Bastion, you gain one extra level 2 spell slot, usable only to cast a spell you have prepared because of a Dragonmark feat.

Empower: House Favor. The hireling calls in a favor from your house: you can use any benefit your Renown Score with it affords, and this favor doesn't count against the favors available to you. You can't do so again until your Renown Score with your house increases.

Source: Eberron: Forge of the Artificer.
